svg.aria-label: 4. Hard puzzle search: ordered pipeline, cancellation
svg.title: 4. Hard puzzle search: ordered pipeline, cancellation
svg.text: 4. Hard puzzle search: ordered pipeline, cancellation

g.text: Search makes two unbuffered channels and starts two workers with wg.Go. Each ranges over jobs and blocks: nothing is sent yet.
It starts a producer and a closer, which waits for the workers. The caller itself ranges over results.
Unbuffered means every send is a handoff to a waiting receiver: seed 10 goes to worker 1, seed 11 to worker 2.
No worker is free, so the producer blocks in its select until one takes seed 12 or the context is cancelled.
Worker 2 finishes first. Seed 11 is out of order: the caller keeps it in the reorder buffer.
Worker 2 asks for the next seed: the producer's waiting send completes. It offers seed 13 and blocks again.
Worker 1 delivers seed 10. Now 10 and 11 are in sequence: the caller emits both, from one goroutine, and writes their files.
Worker 2 finishes seed 12 while the caller is still writing. Its send must wait: back-pressure through the unbuffered channel.
Ctrl-C cancels the context: ctx.Done() is closed. The producer's select wakes up and returns; its deferred close(jobs)
The caller takes seed 12 and emits it. Worker 2's range over the closed jobs ends: it returns, wg counts down.
Seed 13 comes back with an error because it was cancelled. The caller drops it: a gap where the run ends.
The last worker is gone, so wg.Wait returns and the closer closes results. That ends the caller's range loop.
Search returns 13, the first seed not emitted: -from 13 continues the run without holes.
